The heart of this truck is its 3.4L V6 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability, delivering the power and control you need. With 17 city MPG and 22 highway MPG, this Tundra achieves a practical balance between performance and efficiency. The Platinum trim elevates your driving experience with premium materials and thoughtful amenities throughout the cabin.

Safety technology is woven into every aspect of this truck. Forward collision warning with full-speed capability, lane keeping assist, and blind-spot detection work together to help keep you aware and protected. The backup camera and rear park-assist system make maneuvering easier, while stability control and multiple airbags provide comprehensive protection for your passengers.

Inside, the leather-appointed interior creates an upscale environment. Heated and ventilated front seats adjust to your preference, and a heated steering wheel adds comfort during cold weather driving. The power moonroof brings natural light and an open-air feel to the cabin. Dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures every occupant stays comfortable regardless of conditions outside.

Technology integration is seamless with Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto connectivity, allowing you to access your phone's functions safely. The available navigation system, combined with the head-up display, keeps important information visible without distraction. Multiple USB ports and smart phone cables throughout the cabin keep your devices powered and accessible.

The Tundra Platinum's exterior reflects its premium positioning. Twenty-inch dark painted alloy wheels sit beneath the truck, while power running boards provide practical access to the bed. Stainless steel door edge guards protect against daily wear. Heated door mirrors with integrated turn signals and heated windshield wipers ensure visibility in challenging weather.

This truck is built for owners who demand both capability and refinement. Whether you're towing with the included tow package, navigating city streets with advanced safety features, or simply enjoying the commanding presence that comes with a well-appointed Tundra, this vehicle delivers across all fronts. We invite you to experience it firsthand at our showroom.

Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road while managing entertainment.

Safety features have been thoughtfully incorporated throughout the design. Electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain grip during demanding maneuvers. Lane departure warning alerts you if unintended drift occurs, while the robust airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, and overhead airbags for comprehensive protection. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power, and a low tire pressure warning system monitors your tires.

With 74,797 miles on the odometer, this QX60 LUXE has been well-maintained and remains a compelling choice for buyers seeking a versatile, well-equipped three-row luxury vehicle. This 2020 Jeep Compass Latitude delivers capability and comfort in a compact SUV package. With its 2.4L 4-cylinder engine, automatic transmission, and front-wheel drive, this silver crossover achieves 22 city and 31 highway mpg. Well-maintained and ready for the road, it combines practical features with safety technology designed for everyday driving.

- Backup Camera

- Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection
- Full Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus
- Lane Departure Warning Plus
- ParkSense Rear Park Assist System
- Bi-Xenon HID Headlamps with LED Signature
- Power Sunroof
- Remote Start System

The interior reflects thoughtful design with a 7.0 color driver information display, 8-way power driver seat with 4-way lumbar support, and dual-zone automatic climate control. Premium lighting features include auto high beam control and LED taillamps. The Uconnect 4 infotainment system with a 7 touchscreen provides Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration for seamless smartphone connectivity. An 115V auxiliary power outlet keeps your devices charged on the go.

Safety is a priority with this Latitude. You'll find dual front airbags, side-impact protection, anti-whiplash front head restraints, and a comprehensive suite of electronic controls including Electronic Stability Control and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

Come see this well-equipped Compass in person and experience its blend of versatility and modern conveniences. This vehicle is backed by a 3-month, 3,000-mile powertrain warranty, so you can drive with confidence.

I bought this car from Murray Motive in 2021, an automotive shop that my family and I have used for years and trust. Since then, the car has caused me no problems other than needing a new starter in 2024. Other than that, it runs and drives great and has been very reliable.

There are some cosmetic imperfections. The lower front bumper has some indentations from a fender bender, which also left the hood slightly bent. The hood still closes properly. There is also a dent on the left side of the bumper from hitting a raccoon. The auxiliary jack is broken as well.

I would honestly keep driving this car for years if I weren't moving out of the country in November and no longer needed a car. It's been a great, dependable car for me, and I'm hoping to find someone who can get plenty more use out of it.

*Brake assist* detects panic braking and supplements stopping power so you re more likely to stop quickly in an emergency, improving overall braking performance when seconds count.

Convenient cruise control operated from the steering wheel makes setting and adjusting highway speed effortless, reducing fatigue and helping maintain steady fuel consumption on long trips.

We are selling our Porsche Cayenne after 12 years of ownership. Quick stats:
132K miles, no warning lights, garage kept. No accidents, no smoking, no kids. 4 new tires, not in photos (65K mileage warranty).
Features:
Black leather interior, sport chrono package, dynamic suspension (comfort, normal and sport), Bose sound system, Heated Steering Wheel, Bi-Xenon headlights with PDLS, Dual-zone automatic climate control, rear shade screens, 20 executive wheels, panoramic roof, tow package.
Modifications: European side-markers (clear) and remote start (12V solutions) via key or phone.

2026 August: TMPS sensor replaced, 4 new tires (not in photos) COSTCO
2026 April: oil change Mobil 1 0W40 (always)
2025 Feb: oil change, right rear window shade gear, OEM Michelin Pilot Sport AS4.
2024 Feb: oil change, brake flush, fuel system flush, headlight cap recall, cabin filter.
This has been an excellent vehicle for my wife. All systems are working. The hybrid system is NOT the plug-in modern system in current Porsches. This is a much smaller high-voltage battery that accommodates regen braking and start/stop. This means you do not need to worry about the current issues that occur with Porsche PHEV battery packs etc.. The system is very efficient, and our last trip around Austin, we averaged 72 MPH with 26 MPG! That is because the system also disengages the engine when not needed to reduce mechanical friction. This also means it uses the supercharged v6 engine you find in the Audi S4 and Q7 etc. We have always used 0W40 Mobil1 synesthetic oil and premium gas. It comes with 2 keys. The best comp for this vehicle is another 2012 Porsche Cayenne S hybrid is a less desirable color combo, with 118K miles sold for $13,400 last month.

This 2016 Jeep Grand Cherokee Limited offers refined capability with a well-appointed interior and proven all-wheel-drive performance.

- 3.6L V6 24V VVT engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD
- Uconnect 5.0 with GPS Antenna and SiriusXM capability
- Premium Leather Trimmed Bucket Seats with power and heating functions
- Heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic temperature control
- Power liftgate, power door mirrors, and auto-dimming Rear-View mirror
- Exterior rear parking camera with rear parking sensors
- 18 polished aluminum wheels on a four-wheel independent suspension
- Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and brake assist systems
- Four-wheel disc ABS brakes with dual front and side impact airbags
- Memory driver seat with telescoping and tilt steering wheel
- Front fog lights with fully automatic headlights and speed-sensitive wipers
- Heated front and rear seats with split folding rear seat for versatility
- Roof rack rails and rear spoiler for enhanced utility
- Remote keyless entry with security system and garage door transmitter
- Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and trip computer

The white exterior presents a clean, professional appearance while the Limited trim emphasizes comfort and convenience. The leather interior welcomes you with heated front and rear seating, a heated steering wheel, and memory seat positioning. The driver enjoys a power seat that adjusts to your preference, while dual-zone climate control maintains individual comfort throughout all seasons.

Technology is seamlessly integrated through Uconnect 5.0, providing access to SiriusXM satellite radio and navigation features. The audio system includes six speakers and AM/FM capability, controlled through steering wheel-mounted audio controls for safe operation. An overhead console displays essential trip information, while the auto-dimming rear-view mirror with microphone adds practical convenience.

Safety features demonstrate Jeep's commitment to protection, with dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, knee airbags, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. Electronic Stability Control and traction control systems work with four-wheel disc ABS brakes to help maintain control in challenging conditions. Brake assist and low tire pressure warning keep you informed and prepared.

The four-wheel independent suspension with normal duty setup delivers balanced handling and ride quality. Four-wheel drive capability provides confidence on varied terrain, while the 3.45 rear axle ratio supports practical daily driving. The exterior rear parking camera and rear parking sensors assist with maneuvering, making this Grand Cherokee a practical choice for various driving scenarios.

This 2016 Grand Cherokee Limited combines the utility of Jeep's capable platform with the refinement expected in the Limited trim, making it well-suited for buyers seeking a vehicle that balances everyday comfort with genuine all-weather capability.
